stage: J2R2 — OAMD Slot-Reassignment Causal Experiment Preregistration & Autonomous Feasibility Admission

B.target: same 997 Hz source at same Front Right position
B.companion: same 2003 Hz source at same Front Left position
B.assignment: producer/OAMD assignment B, differing only if an independently verifiable slot intervention exists

terminology.authored_source: the controlled 997 Hz or 2003 Hz waveform
terminology.authored_track: the Logic track carrying the source region
terminology.oamd_slot: the decoded dynamic metadata slot index
terminology.reconstruction_row: a structural JOC ReconstructionBasis row index
terminology.position: the independently measured OAMD/ADM spatial state
terminology.basis_contribution: the decoded ReconstructionBasis contribution; never an authored-object stem

candidate_intervention.operation: swap two producer object assignments or another documented producer control while preserving source regions and automation
candidate_intervention.track_order_reorder: not admitted as slot-only intervention; prior J1R11 save/reopen evidence did not show the reorder persisted
candidate_intervention.required_precondition: a documented or directly observable operation must produce a changed decoded OAMD slot assignment

controlled_variables: source PCM, amplitude, phase, start sample and frequency
gain, timing, programme range and duration
bed, routing, channel strips, plugins and project boundaries
encoder profile, bitrate and export settings
nuisance_variables: producer object ordering not known to equal OAMD slot order
global scale, source amplitude, sign or phase
unverified GUI state or object identity

hypotheses.H_POS: target vector is determined by position/state and fixed scene context, not slot
hypotheses.H_SLOT: target vector changes materially when independently verified slot changes
hypotheses.H_ROW_PERMUTATION: both target and companion are explained by one bounded shared row permutation
hypotheses.H_BASE_REALLOCATION: assignment changes base/basis decomposition, so basis-only change is not causal slot evidence
hypotheses.H_NULL_INVALID: slot intervention is not observable or was not applied

required_outputs: total basis energy and corresponding base PCM component
decoder state/profile and exact carrier hashes

analysis.analysis_interval: pre-registered steady-state interval after identical pre-roll; exact AU range to be frozen before media generation
analysis.estimator: coherent least-squares sinusoid projection, retaining complete 15-row vector
analysis.normalization: L2 normalization after row vector extraction
analysis.near_zero: retain rows; do not treat zero/near-zero as semantic identity
analysis.phase: not currently admissible from J1R10 magnitude-only outputs; future use requires declared reference and alignment
analysis.row_permutation: identity plus one independently justified common permutation only; arbitrary 15! search prohibited

thresholds.same_condition_repeat: raw carrier and canonical f64 row artifacts must be byte-identical; otherwise A/B causal classification is invalid
thresholds.f32_numeric_repeat: max absolute sample difference <= 1e-6 when format conversion is unavoidable, based on J1R15 precision evidence
thresholds.material_vector_change: L2 distance > 1e-3; values between thresholds are INCONCLUSIVE
thresholds.base_invariance: exact channel-wise PCM equality where the same-condition path supports it; otherwise max absolute difference <= 1e-6 and no material frequency-energy redistribution
thresholds.oamd_equivalence: exact object count, source identity, position/state and timing equality except the intended verified slot index
thresholds.threshold_source: J1R5 deterministic repeatability/precision evidence and J1R9/J1R10 vector distances; fixed before any future A/B output

base_basis_rule: If base PCM or base-plus-basis energy changes beyond the preregistered repeatability boundary, classify H_BASE_REALLOCATION or H_CONTEXT_OR_REOPTIMIZATION; do not call a basis-only difference H_SLOT.
row_permutation_rule: A row permutation is explanatory only when independently constrained and applied consistently to target and companion; otherwise report row-label ambiguity and do not select H_SLOT.

producer_automation.current_position_authoring: human-assisted automation-lane entry; Object Panner readback only
producer_automation.current_slot_control: no documented, independently verified slot-assignment control
producer_automation.prior_track_order_attempt: J1R11 reorder was not reflected after save/reopen
producer_automation.non_rendering_dry_run: NOT_RUN; prior frozen failure is sufficient and no new Logic interaction is authorized
producer_automation.failure_detection: would require saved project state plus decoded OAMD verification

minimality.why_two_are_needed: one A/B pair is the smallest contrast for a slot-only intervention, but only after exact repeatability and metadata gates
minimality.why_two_are_not_yet_admitted: the producer operation has not been shown to change only OAMD slot assignment; a third carrier cannot repair an unverified intervention
minimality.additional_controls: not justified until a real slot-only control exists
